name: les-bunkers
description: Video production skills from Les Bunkers, a video and podcast studio: a full talking-head edit pipeline, speech cleanup and mastering, vertical clips, and breath / filler detection.

plugins.name: videos
plugins.description: Video pipeline for any project: /videos board, then one skill per stage (new, ingest, transcribe, rough, tighten, audio, grade, master, formats, clips, qc, publish) with a plain-text record per video.

plugins.name: audio-cleanup
plugins.description: Speech cleanup for a DaVinci Resolve edit: reads what the timeline plays, splits two speakers, enhances speech, masters to -14 LUFS, places the tracks back in Resolve and builds an A/B listening page.

plugins.name: vertical-clips
plugins.description: 9:16 clip factory for podcasts and long talking-head videos: sticky face crops, stacked two-person layout, three-transcript caption fixing, -14 LUFS master, word-timed captions and hook in HyperFrames, QC and a review page.

plugins.name: agent-ears
plugins.description: Lets an agent hear breaths and fillers (« euh », "um") in speech so an edit can cut them, plus a blind labelling page and scoring kit to test any detector against your own ears.
